howItWorks.heading: Up and running in three steps

steps.title: Sign in
steps.description: Use your Google account to join the community parking register — no separate password required.

steps.title: Add a spot
steps.description: Enter the location, type and status of a parking spot and pin it on the neighbourhood map.

steps.title: Keep it current
steps.description: Update the spot's status whenever it changes so your neighbours always see accurate, up-to-date information.

items.question: Who can register a parking spot?
items.answer: Any resident who signs in with a Google account can add spots to the register. Each person manages the spots they created.

items.question: Can I see all spots on a map?
items.answer: Yes. The map shows every registered spot as a pin, colour-coded by status, so you know at a glance which are free.

items.question: What types of parking can be registered?
items.answer: You can register covered spots, open outdoor spaces and enclosed garage bays. The type appears on every spot card and map pin.

items.question: How do I mark a spot as taken?
items.answer: Open the spot from your dashboard and change its status to 'occupied' or 'reserved'. The map and list update straight away.

items.question: Is my personal information visible to other residents?
items.answer: Only the spot details you enter — location, type and status — are visible to the community. Your account details remain private.
